Job 23:2: “Indeed, I know that the reproof is from my own hand, and His hand has become heavy upon my groaning.
Job 24:1: “Why did the hours escape the Lord’s notice,
Job 24:2: while the ungodly crossed a boundary, seizing a flock together with its shepherd?
Job 24:3: They led away the orphans’ pack animal and took a widow’s cow as a pledge.
Job 24:4: They diverted powerless people from a righteous road; together the meek of the earth hid.
Job 24:5: They departed like donkeys in a field, going out beyond me to their own activity; bread became sweet to him for the young.
Job 24:6: They harvested a field before its time, though it was not theirs; the powerless worked the ungodly’s vineyards without pay or food.
Job 24:7: They made many lie down naked without garments and took away the covering of their lives.
Job 24:8: They become wet from the mountain showers; because they have no shelter, they clasped a rock.
Job 24:9: They snatched an orphan from the breast and humbled one who had fallen.
Job 24:10: They unjustly made people lie down naked and took the morsel from the hungry.
Job 24:12: People were driven from a city and their own houses; the life of infants groaned loudly. Why has He Himself not made an inspection of these things?
Job 24:13: While they were upon the earth, they did not recognize it; they did not know the road of righteousness or walk in its paths.
Proverbs 1:10: Son, do not let ungodly men lead you astray; do not agree if they invite you, saying,
Proverbs 1:11: Come with us; share in bloodshed. Let us hide a righteous man in the earth unjustly;
Proverbs 1:12: let us swallow him alive like Hades and remove his memory from the earth.
Proverbs 1:13: Let us seize his costly property and fill our houses with spoils.
Proverbs 1:14: Cast your lot among us; let us all obtain a common purse, and let there be one moneybag for us.
Proverbs 1:15: Do not walk in the way with them; turn your foot away from their paths,
Proverbs 1:16: for their feet run toward evil, and they are quick to shed blood.
Proverbs 1:17: For nets are not unjustly stretched out for winged creatures.
Proverbs 1:18: For those who share in murder store up evils for themselves, and the overthrow of lawless men is evil.
Proverbs 1:19: These are the ways of all who carry out lawless deeds, for through ungodliness they take away their own life.
Job 42:7: After the Lord had spoken all these words to Job, the Lord said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “You and your two friends sinned, for you spoke nothing true before Me, as My servant Job did.
Job 42:8: Now take seven calves and seven rams and go to My servant Job, and he will make an offering on your behalf. My servant Job will pray for you, for I will surely accept his person. Were it not for him, I would have destroyed you; for you did not speak truth against My servant Job.”
